text:
marta: quick thread from today's console pass — noticed a few related things across the compact table row actions and toolbar stack: 1) action icons in table rows are visually cramped at narrow breakpoints, 2) modal stacking z-index feels brittle when toasts show over modals, and 3) toast duration for transient errors might be too short for keyboard/screen reader users. screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/console/table-row-actions.png henry: yeah the row actions live in a 48px-high row but the icons are spaced with `--space-compact: 6px`. for icon+label actions we need a slightly larger inline gap. propose a scoped token: `--gap-inline-compact: 10px` used only for table-row actions and toolbar inline groups so other compact patterns don't change. zoya: i like the scoped token idea. avoids regressions. can we also add a visual debug Storybook story showing the hit area overlay so engineers can check the 44px touch target? leo: +1 to the debug story. separate note on modals: currently toasts appear above modals (z-index-wise) which blocks the modal close button sometimes when auto-toasts show. we should ensure modals always have a higher stacking context than transient toasts. maybe tokenized z-index layers like `--z-modal: 800` and `--z-toast: 700`. marta: agree, tokenized z layers = good practice. also, accessibility: short-lived error toasts disappear before keyboard or screen reader users can react. for errors we should extend duration and make them focusable when actionable (tabindex=0), and ensure role=alert is set so SRs announce them. for success toasts keep short polite live region. a11y: a11y-bot: automated smoke flagged that toasts with role=region are missed by NVDA on Windows if duration < 3s. consider 5s for errors or require manual dismiss for actionable errors. henry: proposed toast semantics and timing: error toasts -> `role="alert" tabindex="0" data-duration="5000"` (or persistent until dismissed if a button is present), success toasts -> `aria-live="polite" data-duration="2500"`. sample markup: ```html
\n Row update failed. \n
``` zoya: love that. also add a story showing keyboard focus landing on the toast when an error occurs. add an automated axe check to ensure actionable toasts are focusable and have aria-labels on buttons. leo: regarding z-index: let's adopt a simple stacking token map in tokens/layers.json: `--z-base: 0`, `--z-floating: 100`, `--z-toast: 700`, `--z-modal: 800`, `--z-nav: 900`, etc. that'll make intent clear and avoid ad-hoc numbers in components. marta: small copy inconsistency: in table row hover actions we have one action labelled "Edit" and the modal primary says "Save changes" while the toast says "Updated". could we standardize microcopy: action = "Edit row", modal primary = "Save row", success toast = "Row saved". keeps the noun consistent. henry: sounds good. i'll update tokens/copy.json with those keys: `action.edit = "Edit row"`, `modal.save = "Save row"`, `toast.rowSaved = "Row saved"`. please ping me if we want different localization keys. zoya: for the Storybook work: i'll add three stories — TableRowActions (320px), ModalStackingDemo, and Toasts-a11y. TableRowActions will show icon+label, hit-area overlay, and snapshot. ModalStackingDemo will render a modal and trigger a toast to ensure the modal stays on top in the visual regression. Toasts-a11y will test focus transfer and duration for error toasts. a11y-bot: automated checklist note: ensure that toasts with buttons get meaningful aria-labels for the button text and that role=alert is used only for assertive announcements (errors). Also recommend making persistent/actionable toasts dismissible via keyboard (Escape) and have visible focus ring on toast container when focused. leo: minor implement note: when making toasts focusable we should also add `data-focusable-toast` and ensure focus trapping logic in modals doesn't prevent focusing the toast if it's intended. probably best to move toasts into a separate DOM root within body with appropriate z-index and keep modal focus trapping scoped — toasts should not steal focus from an open modal unless the toast is specifically actionable and we intentionally move focus. need to be careful. marta: good catch. let's define behavior: if toast appears while modal is open and the toast is non-actionable (informational), do not move focus; if actionable error toast appears while modal is open, move focus only if the action is related to the modal content (otherwise leave modal focus intact and make the toast dismissible). we'll document this in the component README. henry: plan-of-action: 1) add `--gap-inline-compact: 10px` token + Storybook TableRowActions + snapshot, 2) add tokenized layers in tokens/layers.json and update modal/toast z-index usage, 3) implement toast semantics (role, tabindex, durations) and a11y story, 4) update copy tokens for Edit/Save/Row saved, 5) docs in component README for toast-modal focus interplay. i'll open one PR with token/story changes and follow-up PR for runtime focus behavior. zoya: i'll implement the stories & axe checks. leo can help review z-index token usage. a11y-bot: queued accessibility smoke for new stories after PR. design-bot: Figma updated: Table & Toast tokens (file: https://figma.redwood.example/file/table-toast-tokens) marta: thanks team. tagging @frontend for implementation reviews. we'll reconvene if any regressions show in snapshots. closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
